exposure: Type of skin antisepsis (povidone-iodine vs. chlorhexidine-alcohol)
cohort: The study included patients undergoing Caesarean section operations at Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital.
finding: The introduction of an infection prevention bundle, including a change in skin antisepsis and improved antibiotic prophylaxis compliance, resulted in the lowest recorded surgical site infection rate of 7.5% and reduced variation.
mod_finding: The findings demonstrate a reduction in surgical site infection rates specifically for Caesarean section operations following the implementation of an infection prevention bundle.
